bioghist.head: Franz Wright (1953-2015)
bioghist.p: Franz Wright was a Pulitzer Prize winning American poet. Son of James Wright, Franz was born in Vienna, Austria and grew up in various areas of the United States including California, the Northwest, and the Midwest. Wright started writing as an adolescent and earned a BA from Oberlin College in 1977 where he met long-time collaborator and friend Dzvinia Orlowsky. He went on to produce award-winning poetry with honors including a Guggenheim Fellowship in 1989, a Whiting Award in 1991, a PEN/Voelcker Award in 1996, and the Pulitzer Prize for Walking to Martha's Vineyard in 2004.

Wright married Elizabeth Oehlkers, an American translator and writer, in 1999 and he then converted to Catholicism. Wright taught poetry at the university level and worked in mental health clinics. He also had a life-long interest in Rainer Maria Rilke and published translations of Rilke and other poets' work during his career.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Collections are processed to a variety of levels, depending on the work necessary to make them usable, their perceived research value, the availability of staff, competing priorities, and whether or not further accruals are expected. The library attempts to provide a basic level of preservation and access for all collections, and does more extensive processing of higher priority collections as time and resources permit.
These materials have been arranged and described according to national and local standards. For more information, please refer to the Yale Archival Processing Manual.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This grouping contains letters written by Franz Wright to Dzvinia Orlowsky of the course of their friendship and working partnership. Wright shares openly with Orlowsky about his work, mental health, and artistic process.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Materials in this grouping are arranged chronologically.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This grouping contains printed copies of emails exchanged between Franz Wright and Dzvinia Orlowsky. Similar to the letters, these emails are a mix of personal and professional correspondence. They also contain manuscripts of many of Wright's published poetry collections including F , Walking to Martha's Vineyard , and Kindertotenwald .

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Materials in this grouping are arranged chronologically.
